topic: Year-end checklist for a digital miner
hook: Own a digital miner? Do this year-end check.

scenes.narration: First, look at the daily rewards credited to your miner.
Second, look at the maintenance charge taken off, which covers electricity and service.
Third, compare the two. Net results vary and can be low or negative, so know your own number.

cta: What does yours show? Tell me in the comments, and the link is on my channel page.
title: Digital Miner Year-End Checklist
description_body: Compare credited rewards with the maintenance charge to see your net result.
